lines.zh: 铜色的羽毛一抖，我迈开腿。
lines.en: My bronze feathers shake as I stride out.

lines.zh: 我走得昂首挺胸，铜光很亮。
lines.en: I walk with my head high, all copper shine.

lines.zh: 爪子在平原的土上划出纹。
lines.en: My claws scratch lines in the plains dirt.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像在打拍子。
lines.en: Each step bobs, like keeping time.

lines.zh: 转头看看，再往前挪一点。
lines.en: I turn my head, then move on a bit.

lines.zh: 太阳照在身上，我像块铜。
lines.en: Sun on me and I look like hammered copper.
Wings tucked, I walk fast.
I skirt the haystack and keep to open ground.
Tail up, I trot along.

lines.zh: 草地太软，我的脚陷下去。
lines.en: The grass is soft and my feet sink.
I lead a few of them from the front.

lines.zh: 咯咯两声，我叫它们跟上。
lines.en: Two clucks — I tell them to follow.

lines.zh: 我抬高一只脚，停了一下。
lines.en: I lift one foot and hold it.

lines.zh: 铜羽互相摩擦，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My bronze feathers rasp together.

lines.zh: 我贴着篱笆走，那里有虫。
lines.en: I walk the fence line; bugs live there.

lines.zh: 这地方虫子多，我慢慢巡。
lines.en: Lots of bugs here; I patrol slowly.

lines.zh: 我站着，铜羽在太阳下发亮。
lines.en: I stand still, bronze feathers shining.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像座小雕像。
lines.en: Perfectly still, like a little statue.

lines.zh: 头一点一点，我在打瞌睡。
lines.en: My head dips; I'm dozing.
I cluck for no reason at all.
I shake the dust off.
I scratch the dirt; no bugs.
Head tilted, I study one blade of grass.

lines.zh: 铜光有点旧了，我理了理羽。
lines.en: The shine's worn; I preen.

lines.zh: 嗉子塞得满满的，我懒得动。
lines.en: My crop is stuffed, and I cannot be bothered to move.
The wind comes and my feather tips sway.
I'm listening to distant clucking.
My eyes blink slowly.
Wings open, then close.
I'll just stand here and not move.
I lift a foot, set it down, and go nowhere.

lines.zh: 阳光的角度变了，我知道时间。
lines.en: The sun's angle shifted; I know the hour.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的样子像在找蛋。
lines.en: You bend like you're hunting eggs.

lines.zh: 我把头偏过去，单眼打量你。
lines.en: I tip my head aside and study you with one eye.
Your hands are empty of grain.
I step back, cautious.

lines.zh: 咯咯叫了一声，算是问你。
lines.en: I cluck once, which is a question.
You're not a fox, so that's fine.
I stretch my neck to look up at you.

lines.zh: 你挪一挪，阳光照不到我了。
lines.en: Shift over; the sun no longer reaches me.
I flutter my wings to look imposing.
My bronze feathers flash in the light.

lines.zh: 你矮下身子，我才肯挪近半步。
lines.en: When you lower yourself, I come half a step nearer.

lines.zh: 你的手一动，我的头就抬起来。
lines.en: Whenever your hand moves, my head comes up.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着跳开，羽掉了一地。
lines.en: I shriek and leap away, feathers everywhere.
My bronze feathers are all mussed.
I run two steps at a tilt.
Don't squeeze me; I'm fragile.
My wing hurts too much to open.
My calls come quick and short.
I duck behind the haystack.
That sent me spinning.
Blood on bronze feathers shows badly.
I flap until I'm steady.
Seeds! My bronze feathers brighten.

lines.zh: 我小跑过去，头一伸一伸。
lines.en: I trot over, head pumping forward.
Scatter it on the ground; easier to pick.
I peck one, then another.
Not enough; I can still eat.
I circle you hunting the spilled bits.
The moment your hand opens, I'm there.
I pecked your finger — sorry.
Good grain; better than bugs.
I tuck one grain under my wing.
Cluck-cluck — I'm pleased.
I'm not snatching; I'm just standing up front.

lines.zh: 低头一大口，铜羽都炸开。
lines.en: A big bite, and my feathers puff up.

lines.zh: 你捏着谷子走，我小跑着跟。
lines.en: You walk off holding grain; I trot after it.
This smell reminds me of the barn.

lines.zh: 我把最后一粒留给同伴。
lines.en: I leave the last grain for the others.
One knock from you and I'm off balance.
I hop away, minus a bronze feather.
Don't step on me; I'm small.
I flap to steady myself.
That knock spun me right around.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要从这道缝挤过去。
lines.en: Let me pass; I squeeze through this gap.
I pecked you — pure instinct.
We collide and both of us squawk.
I back to the fence and go around.
My feathers rasped; I smooth them.

lines.zh: 我张着翅膀绕圈，跳得很起劲。
lines.en: Wings spread, I circle and dance hard.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的羽抖给她看。
lines.en: I ruffle my brightest feathers for her.
She lowers her head and I move closer.
My clucks go soft and gentle.
We settle side by side in the grass.
I peck up a bug and offer it.
This spot would suit a nest.
I scratch out a shallow hollow.
She stays; so do I.
Our bronze feathers touch and ring.
I peck up a seed and swallow it.
This worm is still wriggling.
I carry a grass stem back.
Stones go down to grind my food.
Too hard; I spit it out.
I run with a leaf in my beak.
Something shiny on the ground — mine.

lines.zh: 我把它丢给后面的小鸡。
lines.en: I drop it for the chicks behind me.
Two pecks and I decide it's not worth it.

lines.zh: 东西太小，我一口就没了。
lines.en: So small it's gone in one peck.

lines.zh: 那东西在草里动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something moved in the grass; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我伏低，把半边翅膀撑起来。
lines.en: I crouch low and lift one wing half-open.
The lead bird goes first — that's me.

lines.zh: 我脖子一伸一缩，蓄着劲。
lines.en: My neck pumps as I gather myself.
A snake — I don't like snakes.
I shoo the chicks behind me.

lines.zh: 铜羽全立起来，显得更大。
lines.en: All my bronze feathers stand up to look bigger.
My call rings out — a warning.

lines.zh: 它要靠近，我就啄它眼睛。
lines.en: If it comes near, I'll go for its eye.
I won't give up this ground.
I circle it, keeping side-on.

lines.zh: 它的脚跟一转，我的脖子就跟上。
lines.en: The moment its heel turns, my neck follows.

lines.zh: 我一下一下地啄地，试探。
lines.en: I peck the ground, testing.
It's afraid; I saw it flinch.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，它就退一步。
lines.en: I step in, and it steps back.
Wings spread, I won't fold them.
My calls get shorter and sharper.
I eat up the distance bit by bit.
It goes left; I'm already there.

lines.zh: 我的铜羽在阳光下很显眼。
lines.en: My bronze feathers stand out in the sun.
One peck, square on its nose.
I kick off and launch myself at it.
My wings beat at it to blind it.
I leap and peck at its eyes.

lines.zh: 铜羽炸开，我看起来很大。
lines.en: My feathers flare so I look huge.
Not a heavy blow, but it stings.
Three quick pecks, then I back off.
My claws rake across its face.
I drive it off the grass.
I'm still chasing, clucking all the way.

lines.zh: 我从草里钻出来，铜羽沾着露。
lines.en: I push out of the grass with bronze dew-wet feathers.

lines.zh: 第一声咯咯，整片平原都听见。
lines.en: My first cluck carries across the plain.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，铜光闪了一下。
lines.en: I shake and my copper sheen flashes.
Soft plains soil under my feet.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，阳光晒在铜羽上。
lines.en: I raise my head and the sun warms my bronze feathers.
The flock is near; I walk over.
I tidy the feathers on my wings.

lines.zh: 这儿的土里，虫子一翻就有。
lines.en: Turn the soil here and the bugs come up.
I take my first peck at the dirt.
My shadow's short — it's noon.
My bronze feathers glow hot and I flail.
I hit the ground and my wing folds wrong.

lines.zh: 水淹到脖子，我拼命扑腾。
lines.en: Water's at my neck; I thrash.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，我在半空打转。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I spin through the air.

lines.zh: 那支箭擦掉我几根铜羽。
lines.en: That arrow sheared off a few of my bronze feathers.

lines.zh: 有什么东西让我羽毛发麻。
lines.en: Something makes my feathers go numb.
Too little grain; I can't stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷打在铜羽上，我浑身发亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits my feathers and I light up.

lines.zh: 脚下的地忽然没了，我一路下坠。
lines.en: The ground vanished and I keep falling.
